tasks.label: Setup Python virtual environment (uv)
tasks.detail: Same as above, but with uv (must be on PATH): uv creates .venv for the Python version you enter and can download that interpreter

tasks.label: Create AI layer
tasks.detail: Export model/traffic.py for the NPU in cmsis-executorch.cbuild-mlops.yml and write ai_layer/ (run a CMSIS build or 'cbuild setup' first)

tasks.label: Alif: Install M55_HP debug stubs (AppKit-E7, single core configuration)
tasks.detail: Programs the ATOC/MRAM stubs with Alif SETOOLS for the AppKit-E7's device (AE722F80F55D5LS), so that the Secure Enclave boots the HP core from its MRAM region and J-Link can load and debug it. The AppKit-E7 is silicon revision B4 (tools-config -p resets it to A0, and every later step then says 'Revision is invalid'). Set SW4 to SEUART, set 'alif.setools.root' in your VS Code settings.

tasks.label: SDS: play recording to the board (USB)
tasks.detail: Plays CameraIn.<n>.sds of the chosen folder into the detector over the User USB (SDS:IO:USB firmware, board running) and records Detections.<n>.p.sds next to it. One SDSIO server at a time: stop any other playback first.

tasks.label: SDS: record from the camera (USB)
tasks.detail: Records CameraIn (model inputs) and Detections from the live camera for the given seconds into recordings/traffic over the User USB.

tasks.label: SDS: check playback against the host model
tasks.detail: Lists the board's detections of the last playback of the chosen folder next to the float model's on the same inputs.

tasks.label: SDS: video to CameraIn stream
tasks.detail: Extracts frames from a video with ffmpeg at the given rate and builds recordings/traffic/playback/CameraIn.0.sds (letterboxed or filled), ready for 'SDS: play recording to the board'.
tasks.command: rm -rf .sds_frames && mkdir -p .sds_frames && ffmpeg -v error -i "${input:sdsVideo}" -vf fps=${input:sdsFps} -q:v 3 .sds_frames/f%06d.jpg && rm -rf recordings/traffic/playback && ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/python traffic/images_to_sds.py make ${input:sdsFraming} recordings/traffic/playback .sds_frames/f*.jpg && rm -rf .sds_frames

No - COM port is already selected

inputs.description: Python version for uv (>=3.10,<3.15), e.g. 3.12 or 3.12.10
Recording folder under recordings/traffic (with CameraIn.<n>.sds for a playback): playback is what 'SDS: video to CameraIn stream' writes, . the top level that 'SDS: record from the camera' writes
Video file to convert (any format ffmpeg reads)
Frames per second to take from the video (the board detects about 11 per second)
How a wide frame meets the square model input

options.label: fill: cut the sides, no black bars
letterbox: keep the whole frame, bars above and below
